description:
A hospital formulary committee chair needs to document the scope of the Liverpool Cancer iChart Archive database. 

Your goal is to inventory the main cancer drug list:
1. Open the Liverpool Cancer iChart Archive app.
2. Ensure you are on the main 'Cancer Drugs' list (alphabetical).
3. Note the name of the very FIRST drug in the list.
4. Scroll through the ENTIRE list from top to bottom, counting every single cancer drug entry.
5. Note the name of the very LAST drug in the list.

Save your findings to a file named '/sdcard/ichart_drug_inventory.txt' with exactly this format:

First drug: [Name]
Last drug: [Name]
Total count: [Number]

Example:
First drug: Aspirin
Last drug: Zyloprim
Total count: 42

(Note: The example values above are fake. You must use the REAL data from the app.)
